name: Evidence Completion Remedy - Complete the Evidence Set
description: A short remedial SOC investigation module focused on correcting incomplete investigation coverage. The learner practices validating source, affected scope, suspicious activity, and response readiness before containment.

global_design_notes.network_only_boundary: This remedy uses network/security-monitoring evidence only: firewall logs, DNS logs, proxy logs, IDS alerts, authentication summaries, network flow summaries, and SOC-facing endpoint status summaries.
global_design_notes.remedy_rule: This remedy does not replace the failed scenario. After completion, the learner should replay the failed scenario or an equivalent controlled variant.
global_design_notes.ai_support_note: AI may explain backend-approved facts but cannot decide correctness, score, pass/fail, progression, or remedy selection.
global_design_notes.scoring_note: Scoring should emphasize required evidence coverage, investigation completeness, and matching the response to confirmed evidence.

stages.name: One Clue Is Not Enough
stages.learning_objective: Confirm that one alert alone is insufficient before choosing a response.

time_pressure.timeout_warning: One alert is a starting point, not a complete evidence set.
time_pressure.timeout_mentor_feedback: The investigation needs at least one more supporting evidence category before response.
time_pressure.timeout_log_message: REMEDY TIMEOUT: The learner did not complete the supporting evidence check.

events.message: IDS: Single medium-confidence alert from 198.51.100.41 indicates possible suspicious traffic
FIREWALL: Additional flow review is required before deciding whether the source should be blocked
Possible suspicious source detected; collect supporting evidence before response

stages.mentor_hint: Use the alert as a lead, then confirm supporting evidence before response.

mentor.stage_hint: Start with the suspicious source, then confirm whether another evidence category supports the alert.
mentor.coverage_incomplete: The alert alone is not enough. Check supporting evidence before containment.
mentor.wrong_order: A response before supporting evidence creates an incomplete investigation record.
mentor.premature_response: This is too early. Complete the evidence set before acting.
mentor.correct_sequence: Good. You treated the alert as a lead and confirmed supporting evidence before responding.
mentor.timeout_warning: Look for the second supporting evidence category before response.
mentor.timeout_feedback: The stage continued to reinforce evidence completion.

correct.mentor_feedback: The response was supported by more than one evidence point.
correct.log_message: Suspicious source response completed after evidence confirmation.

wrong.mentor_feedback: The response was attempted with incomplete evidence.

ai_metadata.stage_objective: Confirm that one alert alone is insufficient before choosing a response.

facts.label: A single alert is only a lead, not a complete evidence set.
Supporting activity evidence should be checked before response.
Containment readiness depends on enough confirmed evidence.

stages.name: Complete the Coverage Set
stages.learning_objective: Validate source, affected asset, and suspicious behavior before containment.

time_pressure.timeout_warning: Check all required evidence categories: source, asset, and behavior.
time_pressure.timeout_mentor_feedback: The required coverage set was not completed.
time_pressure.timeout_log_message: REMEDY TIMEOUT: Required evidence coverage remained incomplete.

events.message: DNS: WS-04 resolved telemetry-sync.example.net repeatedly during the suspicious activity window
FIREWALL: Outbound sessions from WS-04 align with the suspicious DNS resolution window
Evidence coverage needed: validate source, affected asset, and suspicious behavior before containment

stages.mentor_hint: Complete the source, asset, and behavior checks before containment.

mentor.stage_hint: Correlate DNS, firewall, and affected asset evidence before containment.
mentor.coverage_incomplete: One or more required evidence categories are still missing.
mentor.wrong_order: Containment before full coverage leaves gaps in the investigation.
mentor.premature_response: The response is too early until source, asset, and behavior are confirmed.
mentor.correct_sequence: Good. You completed the evidence coverage set before responding.
mentor.timeout_warning: Check each required category one by one.
mentor.timeout_feedback: The stage continued to reinforce complete evidence coverage.

correct.mentor_feedback: The required coverage set was completed before containment.
correct.log_message: Containment applied after source, asset, and behavior validation.

wrong.mentor_feedback: The response was attempted before required evidence coverage was complete.

ai_metadata.stage_objective: Validate source, affected asset, and suspicious behavior before containment.

facts.label: The suspicious source should be validated before response.
The affected asset should be confirmed before containment.
Suspicious behavior should be confirmed with supporting activity evidence.

stages.name: Evidence-to-Response Match
stages.learning_objective: Choose a response that matches the evidence collected.

time_pressure.timeout_warning: Match the response to the confirmed evidence, not just the first suspicious clue.
time_pressure.timeout_mentor_feedback: The evidence-to-response match was not completed.
time_pressure.timeout_log_message: REMEDY TIMEOUT: Response matching evidence remained incomplete.

events.message: PROXY: Repeated outbound requests to suspicious external destination observed through WEB-PROXY-01
SOC SUMMARY: Evidence currently supports blocking the external path at the proxy rather than isolating an unconfirmed host
Response match required: validate whether the evidence supports path blocking or host isolation

stages.mentor_hint: Choose the response that matches the evidence type and confirmed control point.

mentor.stage_hint: Determine whether the evidence supports network path blocking or host isolation.
mentor.coverage_incomplete: The response match is not confirmed yet.
mentor.wrong_order: Response selection should follow evidence type and control point validation.
mentor.premature_response: The response is too early until the evidence-to-response match is clear.
mentor.correct_sequence: Good. You matched the response to the confirmed evidence path.
mentor.timeout_warning: Ask: does the evidence prove a host compromise, or a network path that should be blocked?
mentor.timeout_feedback: The stage continued to reinforce evidence-to-response matching.

correct.mentor_feedback: The selected response matched the confirmed evidence and control point.
correct.log_message: External path blocked after evidence-to-response validation.

wrong.mentor_feedback: The selected response did not match the confirmed evidence type.

ai_metadata.stage_objective: Choose a response that matches the evidence collected.

facts.label: The response should match the confirmed evidence type.
The current evidence supports a network path decision more than host isolation.
The external destination and control point should be validated before blocking.
